svg.title: John D. Gómez
svg.desc: John D. Gómez with a steel-blue accent.
svg.metadata: SVG defines a vector image. xmlns names its vocabulary; width and height set its size; viewBox sets the internal coordinate system. role and aria-labelledby associate the image with its title and description by id. text draws characters; x and y set position; fill sets color; font-family, font-size and letter-spacing set typography. rect draws the accent rectangle and rx rounds its corners. A hash followed by six hexadecimal digits is a color. Angle brackets delimit tags; slash closes an element; equals assigns a value; quotes delimit it. Coordinates and sizes are image units, not dates or credentials. D. is part of the public name. metadata holds this source glossary.
